title: sophora tomentosa subsp. polyphylla
intro: Sophora tomentosa subsp. polyphylla, commonly known as the "Korean Sophora" or "Chu-fang-ts'oe", is a species of flowering plant in the pea family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and skin diseases, due to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sophora tomentosa subsp. polyphylla include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including isoflavones, flavonoids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to have potential therapeutic applications in the treatment of various diseases, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
